title: Cosmetics, skincare, health (considered purchase)
when: Buyers compare, read ingredients and reviews before buying.

steps.when: one commercial promise on a dark bar: the usual choice
steps.note: One short promise from the merchant, 35 characters or less (a first-order offer or the delivery terms).

variants.when: a soft brand tint (kids, beauty, playful and premium looks)
2-3 short service promises the merchant confirmed

steps.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop

variants.when: a nested or long menu that would not fit as links
a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)

steps.when: a catalogue look: the hero inside the grid with the theme's rounding
steps.note: 5:2 on desktop, 4:3 on phones, one slide linked as a whole. For a live title and button over it, style the slide as in `hero-bleed-live-text` (size sm, bottom-centred, darkening 16-24).

variants.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text
a photo and a colour panel side by side (playful, premium)

steps.note: What the store sells, for search engines. An optional idea: it pushes the category tiles further down.

variants.when: new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards

steps.note: Shop by need: 1:1, one tint per need, linked. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: more than 4 categories
playful: the names as chips on the photos

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: one product or novelty on a colour block
native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link

steps.when: considered purchases: 3-4 real numbers (years, customers, materials) (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: premium and beauty: one real review set large (kit-custom-sections)
dark drop and playful: a running line of short brand words (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: text cards alternating with photos

steps.note: Reviews: no native reviews block for home; build it with kit-custom-sections.

variants.when: one strong real review with a name and a photo (kit-custom-sections)
customer photos, stores or press the merchant has

steps.when: native fallback: a thin linked strip of 4 words or fewer

variants.when: a strip with more than 4 words: a 4:3 card on phones
a text band with a button and no image (kit-custom-sections)
a centred theme and a brand-led page: a narrow column with air
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card

steps.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band
steps.note: Mention a discount only with a real promocode.

variants.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block
off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

notes: Headings at 2xl (`typography-centred-2xl`): buyers read ingredients and reviews, and at 3xl every section title shouts at the page heading's size (theme.md, Heading levels). Sub-topics go into `content` as `####`.

deviations.category-entry: Bestsellers first; shop-by-need tiles right after them.
deviations.home-length: Seven sections without the optional lead, reviews and gift strip; ten with them.
